items.note: Japan’s Defense Ministry said two suspected Russian aircraft entered Japanese airspace off Fukuoka Prefecture.
A UKMTO warning places a reported engine-room fire seven nautical miles north of Khasab, Oman.
Mayor Zohran Mamdani said he is disbanding the NYPD unit that responds to protests.
The Reserve Bank of Australia’s November minutes show that six of nine board members supported raising the cash rate by 25 basis points to 4.85%.

lead.what: Japan protested after its Defense Ministry said suspected Russian aircraft entered its airspace.

rest.what: A UKMTO warning says a tanker was disabled after a reported attack caused an engine-room fire.

lead.what: Nvidia’s board is reported not to be considering Jensen Huang’s return while Colette Kress remains interim chief executive.
Five governments said concrete negotiations with Rwanda will begin for implementation of a return-hub pilot.

rest.what: New York City announced a restructuring that separates counterterrorism from protest responses.
Three RBA board members preferred to leave the cash rate at 4.60%.
